description.zh: 结束时间。与StartTime间隔时间不能超过4天。格式为：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）。
description.en: The end of the time range to query. The maximum time range to query is four days. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.
The page number of the page to return. Default value: 1.

description.zh: 每页大小。取值范围：5~30，默认值为10。
description.en: The number of entries per page. Valid values: 5 to 30. Default value: 10.

description.zh:
录制文件格式。取值：

m3u8， flv， mp4
description.en:
The format of the recording file. Valid values:

M3U8, FLV, and MP4

description.zh:
排序。取值：

asc（默认值）：升序。

desc：降序。
description.en:
The sorting order of the index files by creation time. Valid values:

asc: The query results are displayed in ascending order. This is the default value.

desc: The query results are displayed in descending order.
The beginning of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.

title.zh: 查询所有录制索引文件
